figures.finding: Mayotte, a department-region of France (where national laws and regulations apply by right under Article 73 of the Constitution), has worked under France's general Labour Code since 1 January 2018, when the separate Mahoran labour code was repealed; no film or stage agreement of Mayotte's own was found, so a performer's, writer's or director's terms there follow France's (whether each national screen agreement's extension reaches Mayotte is a blocker).
